agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consisten.name: agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consistency
agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consisten.value:
("agenda"."profile_subjects"."status" = 'paused' AND "agenda"."profile_subjects"."paused_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("agenda"."profile_subjects"."status" = 'active' AND "agenda"."profile_subjects"."paused_at" IS NULL)

agenda_revision_one_target.name: agenda_revision_one_target
agenda_revision_one_target.value: ("agenda"."activity_revisions"."activity_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("agenda"."activity_revisions"."notice_action_id" IS NOT NULL)

agenda_action_date_origin_check.name: agenda_action_date_origin_check
agenda_action_date_origin_check.value: ("agenda"."notice_actions"."due_at" IS NULL AND "agenda"."notice_actions"."date_origin" = 'unspecified') OR ("agenda"."notice_actions"."due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda"."notice_actions"."date_origin" IN ('school','relative','family'))

agenda_action_time_check.name: agenda_action_time_check
agenda_action_time_check.value: "agenda"."notice_actions"."time" IS NULL OR ("agenda"."notice_actions"."due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda"."notice_actions"."time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

agenda_notification_hours_check.name: agenda_notification_hours_check
agenda_notification_hours_check.value: "agenda"."notification_preferences"."digest_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."quiet_start" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."quiet_end" BETWEEN 0 AND 23
